dedupe_keys.name: china provincial hourly electricity carbon emission factors to 2060

description: The China carbon-flow research team publishes projected electricity carbon-emission factors by province and hour from 2025 to 2060. The Figshare version includes five scenario workbooks, an input-parameter workbook and an annotation PDF. The article states that each scenario has eight five-year-step sheets for 31 provinces and the mainland total, in tonnes of carbon dioxide per megawatt-hour. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The tables can help evaluate electrification and regional power-system scenarios alongside an independent network model such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that these are planning-model projections, not measured future grid intensities. Several underlying optimization and carbon-flow programs are proprietary and are not provided in the deposit, limiting exact reproduction. The own metadata and file list were checked without opening workbook cells, running the proprietary platform or checking uncertainty bounds. The public deposited scenario outputs remain a reusable resource.
